name: HOG異常検出
description: 分析します 勾配 orientation 分布s using Histogram of Oriented Gradients. AI images exhibit more uniform 勾配 orientations than natural scenes.
algorithm: Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) + Entropy Analysis
mechanism: Computes 勾配 magnitudes and orientations, bins them into 9 bins. Higher エントロピー indicates more uniform 分布 typical of AI.
parameters: Bins: 9, Orientation: unsigned [0,PI], Metric: normalized エントロピー
useCase: Detecting uniform 勾配 orientations in AI生成の content

references.title: Dalal, N. & Triggs, B. (2005). Histograms of Oriented Gradients for Human Detection. CVPR.
Felzenszwalb, P.F. et al. (2010). Object Detection with Part-Based Models. IEEE TPAMI.
Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2005). How Realistic is Photorealistic? IEEE TSP.

strengths:
• Captures local shape and 勾配 structure effectively
• Well-proven in computer vision since 2005
• 検出します structural 不整合 in AI生成の content

limitations:
